description: This file defines the VoiceWakeManager class which manages voice wake-word detection, speech recognition, and related audio processing functionalities for an iOS app. It includes audio buffer handling, permission management, and integration with iOS AVFoundation and Speech frameworks.

classes.name: AudioBufferQueue
classes.description: A thread-safe queue for managing AVAudioPCMBuffer objects, used for enqueuing and draining audio data in real-time audio processing.

classes.name: VoiceWakeManager
classes.description: Main class handling voice wake-word detection, speech recognition, and audio session management for the app.

methods.name: makeAudioTapEnqueueCallback
methods.description: Creates a callback function that enqueues audio buffers into an AudioBufferQueue, to be used with AVAudioEngine input taps.

methods.name: AVAudioPCMBuffer.deepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an AVAudioPCMBuffer, duplicating its audio data for safe concurrent access.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.init
methods.description: Initializes the VoiceWakeManager, sets up observers for user defaults changes, and loads trigger words.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.start
methods.description: Begins listening for wake words, handling permission requests, and setting up speech recognition.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.stop
methods.description: Stops listening and tears down the recognition pipeline.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.suspendForExternalAudioCapture
methods.description: Temporarily releases the microphone for external audio capture, pausing voice detection.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.resumeAfterExternalAudioCapture
methods.description: Resumes listening after being suspended for external audio capture.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.makeRecognitionResultHandler
methods.description: Creates a handler to process recognition results and trigger commands when wake words are detected.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.extractCommand
methods.description: Extracts commands from recognized speech based on trigger words and segments.
